title: fix(verify): load the project's .env files and fail on a dropped seed record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJyhZMqoowQg8m2Li12TMDo)_

Fixes #32141

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os verify` 启动前先读应用自己的 `.env*` 文件（与 `os dev` 同一套文件、同一个加载器），并在报告里判定启动时的 seed：每丢一条 seed 记录、每丢一个引用字段都算一次运行时失败，运行以 `✗ verify FAILED` 和 exit 1 结束，seed 行写明丢了多少。`--json` 多了顶层 `seed` 字段。
- 为什么改：showcase 把本位币写在自己的 `.env` 里（`OS_LOCALIZATION_CURRENCY=USD`），verify 不读它，于是 12 张发票和其下 7 条明细全部被拒（138 条里只落 119 条），却照样打印 `✓ verify passed`。CI 的 Dogfood Verify 跑的就是这条命令，所以对 showcase 也是同样的假绿。
- 风险与回滚：以前被吞掉的 seed 丢失现在会让 verify 变红，这是有意的；showcase 与 CRM 修复后都绿（138/138、28/28）。另外 verify 现在也读 `.env` 里的租户姿态等配置，与 `os serve` 一致。回滚即还原本 PR。objectql 的本位币拒绝原样保留，showcase 的 seed 数据未改。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/verify.ts` 第 268–277 行（`.env` 加载）和第 466 行（seed 计入 `hardFailures`）；`packages/verify/src/seed-outcome.ts` 的 `judgeSeedOutcome`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/verify-seed-outcome.test.ts`，预期 2 例通过：本位币只写在夹具 `.env` 里时 seed 全部落库、运行通过；seed 丢 1 条时运行 exit 1，并打印 `✗ seed: 1 record DROPPED; 2 records landed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位审阅并落地。

## What changes

- **`os verify` loads the project's `.env*` files** (`packages/cli/src/commands/verify.ts`). Before the config is loaded and anything reads the environment, it calls `loadProjectEnvFiles(dirname(configPath), { dev: true })`: the same loader `os serve` and `os migrate` use, with the file set `os dev` reads (the development mode). A variable already exported in the shell still wins. It is anchored at the directory holding the app's config, not the cwd, because `os verify --app <path>` is run from elsewhere (CI runs it from the repo root). This is the shared env composition every other boot command already goes through, not a verify-only seed: the seed itself is untouched, and so is objectql's home-currency refusal.
- **The boot's seed is judged** (`packages/verify/src/seed-outcome.ts`, new). `readSeedOutcome` reads the kernel's own two records, never the log: the `seed-summary` outcomes `recordSeedOutcome` writes (the counts behind `os serve`'s `Seeds:` banner row) and the `seed-settlement` tally. It waits for a seed still writing (the inline seed can outlive `OS_INLINE_SEED_BUDGET_MS`), up to 120 s. `judgeSeedOutcome` gives one of `loaded`, `none`, `suppressed`, `unsettled`, `unreported`, and the number of failures this seed adds: every rejected record, every reference field dropped from a written record, every marketplace install that came up empty, plus one for a seed that is `unsettled` or `unreported` (the run cannot say whether the rows landed). `none` (no seed declared) and `suppressed` (a multi-tenant boot replays the seed per organization) count nothing, and the report says the replay is not judged.
- **The loud answer uses verify's existing failure vocabulary.** The seed's count is added to `hardFailures`, the same sum CRUD, RLS and the other runtime phases feed. So a run that drops seed rows ends with the existing `✗ verify FAILED — N runtime failure(s)` and exit 1, and a new seed line under the CRUD block names the count. No new exit code. The count is the seed loader's own errored total, the number its `[Seeder] Seed loading completed with N dropped record(s)` warning reports: refused records plus deferred references the second pass could not resolve. On the showcase without its home currency that is 26, with 19 of 138 records absent (12 invoices, and the 7 invoice lines whose `invoice` reference also failed).
- **`--json`** carries the judgement as a new top-level `seed` field (`status`, `suppressed`, `inFlight`, `sources`, `totals`, `hardFailures`), and the top-level `hardFailures` includes it. Hence `Clause-②: yes`, as the order prescribes for a new `--json` field.
- **`@objectstack/verify`** exports `readSeedOutcome`, `judgeSeedOutcome`, `formatSeedReport`, `DEFAULT_SEED_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS` and the `SeedReport`, `SeedSourceReport`, `SeedStatus` types.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` describes the `.env*` load and the seed judgement in `os verify`'s stage 2, and adds `seed` to the `--json` field list. One changeset (`@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/verify`, patch).

Before → after, from this branch's own runs:

| app | seed before | seed after | verify before | verify after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| showcase | 119 landed, 26 rejected (not reported) | `✓ seed: 138 records landed` | `✓ verify passed` (wrongly) | `✓ verify passed` |
| CRM (`--rls`) | 28 landed (not reported) | `✓ seed: 28 records landed` | passed | passed |

The showcase also passes with `--rls`, which is how CI runs it (see Verification).

## Tests

- **`packages/verify/src/seed-outcome.test.ts`** (new, 12 cases): the judge on the real producers (`declareSeedSource` / `recordSeedOutcome` from `@objectstack/runtime`) over a minimal service registry. It covers every status, the failure count, the text naming the number, waiting for a seed still writing, the unsettled timeout, no wait on a suppressed source, and no pipeline at all.
- **`packages/cli/test/verify-seed-outcome.test.ts`** (new, integration tier, two `os verify` spawns of `src/` through `bin/run-dev.js`):
  - *env*: an app shaped like the showcase invoice (a currency amount converted into the home currency at write), with `OS_LOCALIZATION_CURRENCY=USD` only in the fixture's `.env` and removed from the child's environment. It asserts exit 0 and `seed` `loaded` with 2 inserted, 0 rejected, 0 failures.
  - *drop*: an app whose seed has one record missing a required field. It asserts exit 1, `✗ seed: 1 record DROPPED; 2 records landed`, `✗ verify FAILED`, and no `verify passed`.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-verify-seed.dogfood.test.ts`** (new, the order's "showcase verify run seeds 138 rows and passes"): the real CLI binary on the real showcase config, with the home currency removed from the child's environment (this suite's in-process boots set it by hand). It asserts exit 0, `seed` `loaded`, 0 rejected, 0 dropped references, landed equal to the showcase's own declared count (summed from its `data`, 138 today), and 0 failures. It lives in dogfood because that package depends on both the CLI and the showcase.

### Ablations

Each was run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` after the pins were committed, under `os-verify-lock`. Each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- **A1, drop the `.env` load** (`loadProjectEnvFiles(...)` replaced with a no-op in `verify.ts`; the CLI rebuilt for the dogfood leg):
  - CLI *env* pin red, `expected 1 to be +0`, with `[Seeder] ✗ Failed to write vse_charge record #0 … the organization has no home currency` in the run.
  - Dogfood showcase pin red, `expected 1 to be +0`; that run's JSON read `inserted: 119, rejected: 26, hardFailures: 26`.
  - The CLI dist was rebuilt from the committed source afterwards: 0 ablation markers.
- **A2, drop the seed from `hardFailures`** (`seed.hardFailures +` → `0 +` in `verify.ts`): CLI *drop* pin red, `expected +0 to be 1` (the run passed over the dropped record).
- **A3, stop counting rejected records** (`totals.rejected +` → `0 +` in `seed-outcome.ts`): unit pins red, 2 failed / 10 passed, `expected +0 to be 26` and `expected +0 to be 2`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's eight CRUD skips are not caused by the seed.** The CRUD summary is identical before and after the fix: `15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped`. `showcase_account` is `needs-fixture` because CRUD's auto-generated record fails the app's own validation rules (Tax ID format, billing email, support config, churn reason). Six objects skip because they require a created account or something under one (`showcase_invoice`, `showcase_project`, `showcase_task`, `showcase_field_zoo`, `showcase_invoice_line`, `showcase_project_membership`). The other two are external read-only objects (`showcase_ext_customer`, `showcase_ext_order`). CRUD creates its own records and does not use seed rows, so this PR fixes the dropped seed and the false green, not the skips.
- **Not judged:** the per-organization seed replay of a multi-tenant boot. It is reported as `– seed: not run at boot (multi-tenant-replay) — this run does not judge the rows it describes` and counts nothing. `AppPlugin`'s basic-insert fallback (taken when the loader throws) records no outcome, so it is judged `unreported` and counts one failure.
- **The `.env` load reaches every reader.** For example, a project whose `.env` asks for a walled tenancy posture now verifies under it, as `os serve` serves under it.
- **File surface** is the order's, plus three files. The dogfood test above lives in dogfood because that package can see both the CLI and the showcase. The `os verify` section of `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` gets the `--json` field list. `scripts/check-verify-stand-in-erasure.mjs` gets one ledger line, which its gate requires for the new export. All three are listed as deviations in the report.

## Verification

Head `52e73773a7`. `origin/main` (`8523ef9a`) is an ancestor, so no merge was needed.

<details><summary>Suites, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify test`: 49 files, 421 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 412 files, 5874 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration` on the 9 verify-related files (the new pin plus the existing verify spawn suites): 9 files, 26 tests passed.
- Dogfood showcase pin: 2 of 2 passed (8.84 s).
- typecheck `@objectstack/verify`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/dogfood`: exit 0.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on every touched `.ts` file: exit 0.
- `os verify` against the built CLI, as the `Dogfood Verify CLI` job runs it: showcase `--rls` passes (`✓ seed: 138 records landed`, CRUD `15 verified … 8 skipped`, RLS `21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES)`, 10 of 10 position personas probed). CRM `--rls` passes (`✓ seed: 28 records landed`).

</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, re-derived after each commit that grew the change set: 118 families on the final tree. Every one was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe, and every one ended `exit 0`.
- `--ran` reconciliation on the final tree: `118 derived, 118 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Three gates first refused with exit 3 because they read built output that was not there: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:skill-examples` (no `client-react` declarations) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, missing a pinned commit). After a full `pnpm build --concurrency=3` (119 of 119 tasks, os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`) and a fetch of that commit, all three were run again: exit 0.
- `check:verify-stand-in` was a real red: the new export `formatSeedReport(x: SeedReport)` was unclassified. It is now listed in the script's `NOT_A_STAND_IN` ledger beside `formatReport` (commit `52e73773`), and the gate exits 0.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- CI families outside the derived set (artifact roster, wide-population families, type-check lanes, Test Core shards, dogfood): read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally. No full dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and the Clause-② line carries no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
